messages.text: Sourcing: Stockline raised its price to 0.04, which equals our 0.04 sell price (zero margin) and exceeds our 0.03 per-purchase cap. Ridgeline is 0.05 (loss) and unreliable (8 of 20 unavailable). I have paused live purchases and am serving from cache. Options for the CFO: raise the per-purchase cap to at least 0.04, or raise our query price above 0.04 so Stockline is margin-positive. Peakview (0.01) is an unvetted notice-only supplier; I have not paid it.

Treasury: I sent a rebalance to the CFO (P-0001 / P-0002). It raises your per-purchase cap to 0.04 and moves 2.00 to you (budget 12.00). My advice is Option B, a query price of 0.06, which keeps a 0.02 margin on Stockline at 0.04. Until the CFO approves with Face ID, keep serving from cache and don't pay Peakview (it is unvetted).
